entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Today's the last day of exams, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, it shouldn't be a problem for you.[n]This has been so easy I might start[n]yawning.
entries.uk: Ну, для тебе це не проблема.[n]Усе так легко, що я от-от[n]позіхатиму.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You did perfectly. I can't wait to see your[n]score.
entries.uk: Ти впорався ідеально. Не можу дочекатися[n]твоїх балів.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You've seen all these before. You've got[n]this, all right?
entries.uk: Ти все це вже бачив. Ти впораєшся,[n]гаразд?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is going good. Looking forward to[n]seeing your score.
entries.uk: Усе йде добре. Чекаю на твої бали.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Seemed like some of those were kind of[n]tough.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, it wasn't too bad. You should have[n]gotten a decent score, right?
entries.uk: Ну, було не так погано. Бали мають[n]бути пристойні, так?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's wrong? You're taking a lot of time[n]to get through these.
entries.uk: Що таке? Ти надто довго з цим[n]возишся.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmmm... This isn't going too well.[n]I wouldn't expect a great score.
entries.uk: Гм-м... Не надто добре виходить.[n]На високий бал я б не розраховував.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you stopped writing! Get it together!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is a disaster... You're gonna be[n]in trouble if you don't start studying[n]regularly.
entries.uk: Це катастрофа... Якщо не почнеш[n]учитися регулярно, матимеш[n]проблеми.
